s.note: Warm choux puffs baked with gruyère, nutmeg and black pepper
s.how: Bring 125ml water, 60g butter and half a tsp salt to the boil, tip in 75g plain flour and beat over the heat for 2 minutes until it pulls away from the pan. Cool for 5 minutes, then beat in 2 eggs one at a time, 60g grated gruyère, a pinch of nutmeg and pepper. Spoon 20 small mounds onto lined trays, top with another 20g gruyère and bake at 200C for 25 minutes until puffed and deep golden.

s.n: Zion temple flatbreads with smoked eggplant
s.note: Charred eggplant whipped with tahini, lemon and garlic, with warm torn flatbreads
s.how: Char 2 large eggplants over a gas flame or under a hot grill for 20 minutes, turning, until collapsed and smoky. Cover in a bowl for 10 minutes, peel and chop the flesh. Mash with 3 tbsp tahini, the juice of a lemon, a crushed garlic clove, 2 tbsp olive oil and salt. Warm 4 flatbreads in a dry pan and brush with oil. Finish the dip with more oil, smoked paprika and parsley and serve with the torn bread.

m.note: Chicken braised in red wine with bacon, mushrooms and baby onions, over buttery mash
m.how: Season 8 skin-on chicken thigh cutlets and brown in a tbsp of oil in a heavy casserole, then set aside. Fry 150g bacon lardons until crisp, add 30g butter, 12 peeled pickling onions and 300g button mushrooms and colour for 8 minutes, then 2 garlic cloves. Stir in 2 tbsp flour and 1 tbsp tomato paste, pour in 500ml red wine and 250ml chicken stock, add thyme and 2 bay leaves, return the chicken and simmer covered for 35 minutes, then 10 minutes uncovered. Mash 1kg boiled potatoes with 60g butter and 100ml warm milk and serve with the chicken and parsley.

w.note: Dense dark chocolate and almond cake under a glossy chocolate ganache
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk 4 eggs and 150g caster sugar until pale and thick, fold in the chocolate, then 50g almond meal, 30g plain flour, 2 tbsp cocoa and a pinch of salt. Bake in a lined 20cm tin at 170C for 30 minutes until just set and cool for an hour. Pour 100ml hot cream over 100g chopped dark chocolate, stir until glossy, pour over the cake and let it set before slicing.

d.note: Blackcurrant liqueur topped with chilled sparkling wine and a blackberry
d.how: Chill 4 flutes. Pour 15ml crème de cassis into each, top slowly with chilled dry sparkling wine and drop in a blackberry.
